column3: Generate Mutants: The tool creates variations of your code (mutants) Run Tests: Each mutant is tested against your test suite Kill or Survive: If tests fail, the mutant is "killed" (good). If tests pass, it "survives" (bad) Calculate Score: Mutation Score = Killed Mutants / Total Mutants

PCA is sensitive to feature scales. Without standardization: Features with larger values dominate variance Example: Sepal length (4-8 cm) would dominate petal width (0.1-2.5 cm) Result: Principal components biased toward large-scale features StandardScaler transforms each feature to zero mean and unit variance: After standardization, all features contribute equally to PCA.
